mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_contract_supplier ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT * FROM tb_contract_supplier WHERE supplier_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR supplier_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT ${supplierIdColumn} AS supplier_pk FROM tb_user_detail WHERE ${userIdColumn} = #{userId}
SELECT ${supplierIdColumn} FROM tb_user_detail WHERE ${userIdColumn} = #{userId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT IS_SUPPLIER_ADMIN FROM tb_user_detail WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
SELECT account FROM blade_user WHERE ${pkColumn} = #{userId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT r.role_name FROM blade_user_role ur INNER JOIN blade_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND IFNULL(ur.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(r.is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT SUPPLIER_CLIENT FROM tb_user_detail WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_purchase_parts_order WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND supplier_order_status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0 AND require_attr = '订单'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_purchase_parts_order WHERE supplier_order_status = 0 AND order_status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND require_attr = '订单'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_srm_asn WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'SHIPPED') AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_srm_asn WHERE status IN ('CREATED', 'SHIPPED') AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ship_qty), 0) FROM tb_srm_asn WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND actual_eta_date = CURDATE() AND status = 'SHIPPED' AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ship_qty), 0) FROM tb_srm_asn WHERE actual_eta_date = CURDATE() AND status = 'SHIPPED' AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) FROM tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON d.order_id = o.id WHERE IFNULL(d.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(o.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND o.require_attr = '预测' AND d.supplier_order_status = 0 AND o.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
SELECT * FROM blade_user WHERE ${accountColumn} = #{account} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT * FROM tb_user_detail WHERE ${userIdColumn} = #{userId} AND IFNULL(IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE blade_user SET ${passwordColumn} = #{encryptedPassword} WHERE ${pkColumn} = #{userId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
